bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches are allowed at House of Blues Chicago. Every bag is searched, and bags that are not clear get an extra search.
allowed: Bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, clear or not
prohibited: Bags larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
Personal video cameras, GoPros, selfie sticks and drones
Professional audio and video equipment, including detachable lenses and tripods
bagPolicy.note: Coat check is $5 and merch check is $10, card only, in the winter season and when the weather calls for it. There is no re-entry.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at House of Blues Chicago can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by House of Blues Chicago. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: House of Blues Chicago offers a Southern-inspired menu with made-from-scratch dishes. Highlights include BBQ nachos, smoked buffalo wings, jambalaya, and a variety of salads and mains like blackened salmon and baby back ribs. The venue also features a selection of burgers and sandwiches.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Limited storage is available for wheelchairs, canes, walkers, and other mobility devices.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not permitted after you leave the venue.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office opens at 12pm on show days only. Tickets bought through Live Nation or Ticketmaster can be picked up at the Box Office any time it's open. Call 312.923.2000 with questions.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: For most shows, a qualifying purchase at the House of Blues Restaurant & Bar or the Gear Shop on show day gets you a Pass the Line voucher for priority entry before the general public. VIP and Meet & Greet check-in may start before doors open, so follow the time in your VIP confirmation email.
